title: Implement section list panel component
description: Implement the SectionListPanel component used in the editor. Shows all sections in the current landing page with options to reorder, show/hide, regenerate, or remove each section.
acceptanceCriteria: SectionListPanel renders a list of all sections in page order
Each row shows section type icon and label
Each row has: Toggle visibility (eye icon), Regenerate (refresh icon), Remove (trash icon) actions
Sections can be reordered by drag-and-drop
Toggling visibility hides/shows the section in the preview
Remove removes the section from page_data
Verify in browser with Playwright screenshot

steps.details: Client component. Props: `sections: Section[], onReorder, onToggle, onRegenerate, onRemove`. Render a list of section rows with type label and action buttons.
Use `@dnd-kit/sortable` for drag-and-drop. Each section row is a sortable item. On drag end, call `onReorder(newOrder)` with the updated section array.
Toggle: set section.hidden = true/false, call onToggle. Regenerate: call POST /api/generate/prospect/[slug]/section, then call onRegenerate with new data. Remove: confirm dialog, call onRemove.
Take Playwright screenshot. Verify sections list shows all sections. Drag one to reorder. Verify preview updates.
